verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.90
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.90

verses.pali: 9. Theravagga
verses.english: 9. Senior Mendicants

verses.pali: Dutiyasekhasutta
verses.english: A Trainee (2nd)

verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “These five things lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu bahukicco hoti bahukaraṇīyo viyatto kiṅkaraṇīyesu;
verses.english: Firstly, a mendicant trainee has many duties and responsibilities, and is competent in many tasks.

verses.pali: riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They neglect retreat, and are not committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the first thing that leads to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu appamattakena kammena divasaṁ atināmeti;
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee spends too much time doing trivial work.

verses.pali: riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They neglect retreat, and are not committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the second thing that leads to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu saṁsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṁsaggena;
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee mixes closely with laypeople and renunciates, socializing inappropriately like a layperson.

verses.pali: riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They neglect retreat, and are not committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the third thing that leads to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu akālena gāmaṁ pavisati, atidivā paṭikkamati;
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee enters the town at the wrong time, and returns too late in the day.

verses.pali: riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They neglect retreat, and are not committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fourth thing that leads to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu yāyaṁ kathā ābhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā, seyyathidaṁ—
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee doesn’t get to take part in talk about self-effacement that helps open the heart, when they want, without trouble or difficulty. That is,

verses.pali: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṁsaggakathā vīriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, evarūpiyā kathāya na nikāmalābhī hoti na akicchalābhī na akasiralābhī;
verses.english: talk about fewness of wishes, contentment, seclusion, aloofness, arousing energy, ethics, immersion, wisdom, freedom, and the knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They neglect retreat, and are not committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fifth thing that leads to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These five things lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These five things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu na bahukicco hoti na bahukaraṇīyo viyatto kiṅkaraṇīyesu;
verses.english: Firstly, a mendicant trainee doesn’t have many duties and responsibilities, even though they are competent in many tasks.

verses.pali: na riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They don’t neglect retreat, and are committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the first thing that doesn’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu na appamattakena kammena divasaṁ atināmeti;
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee doesn’t waste their day doing trivial work.

verses.pali: na riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They don’t neglect retreat, and are committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the second thing that doesn’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu asaṁsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṁsaggena;
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee doesn’t mix closely with laypeople and renunciates, socializing inappropriately like a layperson.

verses.pali: na riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They don’t neglect retreat, and are committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the third thing that doesn’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu na atikālena gāmaṁ pavisati, nātidivā paṭikkamati;
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee doesn’t enter the village too early or return too late in the day.

verses.pali: na riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They don’t neglect retreat, and are committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fourth thing that doesn’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu yāyaṁ kathā ābhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā, seyyathidaṁ—
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant trainee gets to take part in talk about self-effacement that helps open the heart, when they want, without trouble or difficulty. That is,

verses.pali: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṁsaggakathā vīriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī;
verses.english: talk about fewness of wishes, contentment, seclusion, aloofness, arousing energy, ethics, immersion, wisdom, freedom, and the knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: na riñcati paṭisallānaṁ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṁ cetosamathaṁ.
verses.english: They don’t neglect retreat, and are committed to internal serenity of heart.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fifth thing that doesn’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These five things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
Theravaggo catuttho.
Tassuddānaṁ
Rajanīyo vītarāgo,
kuhakāssaddhaakkhamā;
Paṭisambhidā ca sīlena,
thero sekhā pare duveti.
